title: Associate Professor of Public Policy
bio: Michela Carlana is an Associate Professor of Public Policy at Harvard Kennedy School. She is affiliated with the Center for International Development, Malcolm Wiener Center for Social Policy, and Women in Public Policy Program.
research_interests: Michela and Marco Tabellini. "Happily Ever After: Immigration
and Fertility." HKS Faculty Research Working Paper Series RWP18-035
